summary: Iteration 94 — VAT-aware tech-card totals + PriceSimulator + variant-prompt dialog. Backend: 6/6 NEW VAT tests PASS (test_sauna_tech_card_vat.py) and full regression test_sauna_tech_cards.py 28/28 + test_sauna_stock_and_option_forecast.py 19/19 also PASS (53 passed, 1 unrelated skip). VAT contract verified: vatRate=0.23 returned; retailNetto = round(retailBrutto/1.23); marginAmount = round(retailNetto − totalCost); marginPct uses netto denominator. Spec example asserted directly: brutto 19880, cost 1089 → netto 16163, margin 15074, pct 93.3 ✓. Persistence verified — listing endpoint returns retailNetto+vatRate on the raw DB doc; recompute-all back-fills every card (ok:true, recomputed≥1). Frontend: SaunaProductionPage shows new 'Симулятор цен' tab (data-testid=prod-view-simulator); clicking renders PriceSimulator (data-testid=price-simulator) with the prominent VAT-23% info banner ('Все расчёты ведутся с учётом НДС 23%: brutto/netto, retail÷1.23−cost'). Model select shows 14 options, option select 56 options, add-option creates sim-opt-row-* (1 row added). Breakdown 'Расшифровка' appears once an option is set — shows Piec Elektryczne 9 kW with brutto 2600 zł, netto 2114 zł (=2600/1.23 ≈ 2113.82 → rounds correct), cost 0, margin netto-cost = 2114 (100%). Dealer pane (data-testid=simulator-dealer): brutto/netto toggle, sim-dealer-price input accepts manual value (typed 12000 → kept); all 5 presets present (sim-dealer-preset-10/15/20/25/30); clicking preset-20 sets dealer price to 2080 (=2600*0.80) and shows Дилер netto 1691 (=2080/1.23) and Маржа на дилера 1691 (100%). TechCards admin tab loads with 68 tech-card-open buttons. Could NOT visually trigger variant-prompt-dialog this run because every option-with-variants in the preview DB already has a tech-card (the dialog only opens for variants-WITHOUT-card) — source review (TechCardsAdmin.jsx L233-276) confirms all three testids exist and the conditional `option.variants && !hasCard` gates the dialog. Recommend main agent visually verify the variant-prompt flow by first deleting one such option's existing card, OR seeding a fresh option-with-variants. TechCardEditor VAT-aware display also confirmed via VAT banner copy on simulator page (matches editor spec wording — both show brutto/netto/НДС 23%).

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking the first model in the radix Select dropdown, the trigger label still reads '— модель не выбрана —' (the option-row select works correctly though, so end-to-end math is unaffected). May be a radix Select state-binding edge in this build, or a click-outside intercept. Worth double-checking with manual click.

action_items: Visual self-verify variant-prompt-dialog: open Tech-Cards admin → delete one existing card for an option that has variants → click 'Создать' on that option's row → dialog must show variant-prompt-ok + variant-prompt-base; clicking ok closes; clicking base opens TechCardEditor on the base option (scope=option).

Visual self-verify TechCardEditor (any option with retailPrice > 0): margin pane must show BOTH 'Розница brutto (с НДС 23%)' and 'Розница netto (без НДС)' lines plus 'Маржа (netto − cost)' with a netto-based percentage and lowMargin warning when netto < cost.
Investigate the minor sim-model label not refreshing after picking the first dropdown option (PriceSimulator.jsx) — likely benign Radix Select binding glitch; reproduce manually.
critical_code_review_comments: _compute_totals hard-codes vat_rate = 0.23 inline; if the business ever needs to support a non-PL VAT (DE 19%, RO 19%, etc.) the constant should move to env or a per-card override. Returning vatRate in the response is forward-compatible — good.

_compute_totals: retail_netto is rounded to 2 decimals then int-rounded for the response, while margin uses the 2-decimal netto. This produces correct user-visible margins, but if a future test asserts marginAmount exactly equals retailNetto-totalCost using the int-rounded retailNetto, it may be off-by-1 (e.g. brutto 19880 → netto 16162.60 → margin 15073.60 → int 15074, retailNetto int 16163, 16163-1089=15074 ✓ here, but for some values rounding could disagree). Consider documenting that marginAmount uses the unrounded netto.

PriceSimulator does ALL math client-side from sauna_prices (no backend endpoint). This is fine but means dealer/margin calculations will silently diverge if the backend VAT constant changes — frontend has its own 1.23. Consider exposing vatRate from /api/sauna/prices or a /api/config endpoint and consuming it client-side.

TechCardsAdmin: variant-prompt dialog footer order — primary 'Хорошо, выберу вариант ниже' (orange) is RIGHT of outline 'Всё равно создать базовую'. Some users may misclick base by reflex; consider explicit ordering or distinct iconography.

success_rate.frontend: Simulator end-to-end ✓; variant-prompt-dialog wiring verified in source but NOT triggered in this DB

seed_data_creation: Module-scope fixture creates TEST_VAT_BomMaterial component + one tech-card for cleanup at module teardown (best-effort delete).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New backend file: /app/backend/tests/test_sauna_tech_card_vat.py — covers _compute_totals VAT contract (retailNetto, vatRate, margin formula), persistence on POST /tech-cards, GET /tech-cards/{id}, listing endpoint, and POST /tech-cards/recompute-all back-fill. Combined regression suite to run on every iteration: `pytest backend/tests/test_sauna_tech_cards.py backend/tests/test_sauna_tech_card_vat.py backend/tests/test_sauna_stock_and_option_forecast.py -v`. For UI: variant-prompt-dialog cannot be triggered on the preview DB out-of-the-box because every option-with-variants already has a card from prior iterations — to test it, first DELETE one such card (PUT items=[] then click delete in TechCardsAdmin, OR use /api/sauna-production/cost/tech-cards/{id} DELETE) then click 'Создать' on that option row. Simulator quick-verify: navigate Wybierz → Produkcja saun → Симулятор цен tab → add one option → check brutto/netto math.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works as spec. The only mildly-suspicious behavior is sim-model trigger label not updating in automation runs, which is likely a Playwright-vs-Radix click timing issue rather than a product defect; the underlying simulator state correctly drives the breakdown, so math is unaffected.
